Reranking where NVIDIA NIM lists the scored documents under rankings with a logit

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.rerank("{\"documents\":[\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\",\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\"],\"model\":\"nvidia_nim/nv-rerankqa\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
